purpose: Source A approved style and camera-direction gate for art replacement

source_a_art_direction.roof: slate-grey small tiled and occasional muted straw
source_a_art_direction.wood: warm peach-brown framing and rough plaster
source_a_art_direction.fx: subtle local accents, not exaggerated gold/dragon halos

direction_policy: Only one verified source image per model; second direction requires independently authored sprite with matched projected footprint, entrance, pivot, and non-mirrored asymmetric props

main_hall.notes: slate layered roof; warm-peach wood, stone square, courtyard tree, pale turquoise crystals

residence.notes: small asymmetric slate roof, wicker lamp, rose planter, woodshed; avoid oversized tiered palace

warehouse.notes: straw roof over low slate-wood annex, jars/crates/cart/timber

forge.notes: teal-grey tile with dark soot roof, open high furnace flame, warm wood base

guidance.notes: slate-jade portal, restrained mint energy, lotus plants, square stone walkway

forbidden_shortcuts: flip_h as independently authored second direction
fake production VFX or material balances
replace assets without in-game visual QA
